verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can bring in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite. Connected sources sync on demand and refresh nightly, and past months can be re-imported after fixes in the books, so no manual exports are needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the accounting connectors, and detail on Xero- and NetSuite-specific sync behavior.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my accounting platform (QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite) and actuals land in the model without manual exports

citations.quote: Bring in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet.
